principle: Premium Gold is an optional Com Design theme and pattern vocabulary. It does not replace the default Electric Indigo palette or core component contracts.

colorRoles.brand: Orange-red is for brand identity, primary action and scoped selection.
colorRoles.reward: Champagne gold is for value, points, rewards, benefits and redeemable assets; it is not a generic CTA color and must not replace Warning.
colorRoles.member: Ink surfaces are reserved for high-level membership identity or premium benefit containers; they are not the default page surface.
colorRoles.status: Success, Warning and Danger keep their original Com Design semantic colors.

patterns.name: Reward Balance
patterns.intent: Present a user's accumulated value and the next meaningful action without turning the whole page gold.
rules: Use gold for the value asset, badge, coin/bubble icon or a restrained highlight.
Keep the container on normal or warm surface; do not fill the entire card with saturated gold.
Primary action still uses scoped Brand action color, not Reward gold.

patterns.name: Reward Earned
patterns.intent: Celebrate newly earned value while keeping feedback hierarchy readable.
rules: Reward color communicates value; Success communicates task completion. Do not merge the two meanings.
Use motion or illustration sparingly; the amount and source of the reward remain the information focus.
Do not use Reward gold as an error, warning or loading state.

patterns.name: Redemption Code
patterns.intent: Support codes obtained from enterprise WeChat, campaigns or partner channels with a clear game-like redeem interaction.
rules: The code input and submit action follow normal Form/Button contracts.
Reward styling may frame the redeemable outcome, but the input itself stays high-contrast and conventional.
Success, invalid, expired and already-used states must use semantic feedback, not different shades of gold.

patterns.name: Member Identity
patterns.intent: Create a premium identity moment without converting the full application into a dark luxury theme.
rules: Use Ink as a bounded identity surface: membership card, header block or benefit summary.
Gold is an accent for tier, value or entitlement; it should not become body text.
Return to standard/warm surfaces for ordinary content below the identity block.

patterns.name: Benefit Card
patterns.intent: Describe a concrete benefit with clear availability and action state.
rules: The benefit title and usable condition are more important than decorative gold.
Unavailable/expired benefits use disabled or status semantics instead of desaturated-gold invention.
Cards remain structurally compatible with Com Design Card spacing/radius/elevation rules.

patterns.name: Reward Ledger
patterns.intent: Show earn/spend history with amount direction, source and time at high scan speed.
rules: Use typography and +/- amount direction before color to distinguish earn and spend.
Gold may emphasize positive value, but negative/spend entries are not Danger unless an actual error occurred.
Keep rows visually quiet; this is a data list, not a stack of promotional cards.
